categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three major segments: information electronics, communication electronics, and consumer electronics. Its product portfolio includes notebooks, desktop PCs, motherboards, servers, cable modems, set-top boxes, smartphones, game consoles, tablets, wearable devices, smart home devices, and automotive electronics. It also engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, and maintenance services for these products and their components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on integrating core hardware and software technologies, including AI computing, high-speed transmission, and advanced cooling technologies such as liquid cooling for AI servers. It develops products based on platforms like Intel, AMD, Nvidia, and Qualcomm, and employs advanced manufacturing processes including precision component placement, reflow soldering, and automated assembly. The firm also invests in modular design, energy-efficient materials, and sustainable manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global brand manufacturers in the IT, communication, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves end markets including enterprise, education, gaming, automotive, and smart home applications. Major customers include leading PC and smartphone brands, with significant sales in North America, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Taiwan, China (Suzhou, Shanghai, Chongqing), the United States, Mexico, Czech Republic, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, and India. Sales and service centers are distributed across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and other regions, supporting a worldwide customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as an ODM/EMS provider, positioned in the midstream of the electronics supply chain. It undertakes design, manufacturing, and assembly services, integrating upstream components sourced from suppliers and delivering finished products to downstream brand customers. It also engages in vertical integration by managing component production and assembly processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI-related technologies such as AI servers, generative AI, agentic AI, and digital twins for metaverse applications. The company invests heavily in R&D for high-speed communication (5G, WiFi 7/8, 6G), automotive electronics including smart cockpits and LiDAR, wearable devices with AR capabilities, and smart medical devices. Sustainability and energy efficiency are also key R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales under ODM/EMS contracts, including design and manufacturing services for information electronics, communication devices, and consumer electronics. The company also earns income from strategic investments and ancillary services such as after-sales support and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other major Taiwanese ODM/EMS firms such as Quanta, Compal, Wistron, and Inventec. It holds a significant global market share in notebook manufacturing (~4.56%) and maintains competitive advantages through scale, vertical integration, R&D capabilities, and global manufacturing footprint. It positions itself as a high-value solution provider emphasizing innovation and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.125 trillion, representing a 10.46% decline year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$16.9 billion, showing growth despite revenue decline. The company maintains a strong asset base exceeding NT$674 billion and continues to invest over NT$11 billion annually in R&D. It has a stable financial position with ongoing capacity expansions and global operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated hardware-software solutions, advanced AI and high-performance computing capabilities, and sustainable manufacturing practices. Its vertical integration and global supply chain flexibility enable rapid response to market changes and customer needs. The firm differentiates itself through innovation in AI servers, automotive electronics, and smart devices, combined with strong customer relationships and comprehensive after-sales services.
